qualifiers.scope: on-demand streams; On-demand Advantage is an account-level setting

evidence.quote: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams launches On-demand Advantage, so customers can warm on-demand streams to handle instant throughput increases up to 10GB or 10 million events per second, eliminating the need to over-provision or build custom scaling solutions.

evidence.heading: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams launches On-demand Advantage mode

evidence.quote: On-demand Advantage is an account-level setting that unlocks more capabilities and provides a different pricing structure for all on-demand streams in an AWS Region.
